grammar.title: Having no choice with 不得不
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 不得不 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 不得不 (bùdébù) means "can't help but, have no choice but to" — it shows the subject is forced into an action by circumstances, not by their own will. It goes right before the verb.

grammar.title: Usually, normally with 通常
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 通常 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 通常 (tōngcháng) means "usually, normally" — it describes what typically happens, similar to 一般. It goes before the verb, often at the start of a sentence about daily habits.

sentences.zh: 你说什么都没用，反正他不会同意。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shuō shénme dōu méi yòng, fǎnzhèng tā bù huì tóngyì.
sentences.en: No matter what you say, he won't agree anyway.

sentences.zh: 反正时间还早，我们慢慢走吧。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎnzhèng shíjiān hái zǎo, wǒmen mànmàn zǒu ba.
sentences.en: It's still early anyway, let's walk slowly.
